title: Multidimensional factors influencing the recovery trajectory of residual dizziness after successful canalith repositioning in benign paroxysmal positional vertigo: an ordered logistic regression analysis
authors: Yu M, Lei C, Zou T, Su J, Lu H
direction: 方向4：BPPV/前庭康复 — 残留眩晕恢复轨迹
pdf_status: failed (2026 新文, EPMC 收录时滞, isOpenAccess=N; 下轮 EPMC 复查 PMCID)
abstract: To explore the multidimensional factors associated with the recovery trajectory in patients with persistent residual dizziness (RD) following successful repositioning for BPPV. Retrospective, 169 patients with BPPV and persistent RD. Primary outcome: RD recovery trajectory (ordinal, Day 7 & Day 14 follow-up). Univariate analysis and ordered logistic regression.
